Senior Python Developer

Company: TechCorp India

Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Mode: Hybrid

Experience: 3-6 years

Salary: ₹8 - 14 LPA

Posted on: 15 Jan 2025

About the Role

TechCorp India is hiring a Senior Python Developer to join our growing engineering team. You will design and build scalable backend services using Python and FastAPI.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement REST APIs using FastAPI and Django
  • Write clean, testable Python code with high coverage
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers on API contracts
  • Optimize PostgreSQL queries and database schema
  • Participate in code reviews and architecture discussions

Requirements

  • 3+ years of Python development experience
  • Strong knowledge of FastAPI, Django, or Flask
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and Redis
  • Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or Jenkins)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Apache Kafka or message queues
  • Knowledge of AWS or GCP
  • Contributions to open-source projects

Benefits

  • Competitive salary: ₹8 - 14 LPA
  • Health insurance for employee and family
  • Flexible work hours
  • Annual learning budget of ₹50,000

How to Apply

Send your resume to careers@techcorp.in or apply at https://techcorp.in/careers/apply?role=senior-python-dev
